sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the integration of thinking mode (for complex, multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode (for rapid, context-driven responses) into a unified framework.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.title: QwenLM/Qwen3 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Qwen3 consists of multiple model families with different architectural approaches and capabilities. The system supports both dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures across various parameter scales.
